title: GOAL: kgpt cowork with GitHub repos — bind a project to a repository, keep it in sync, edit, diff, commit and PR by proposal, from chat and the Cowork UI
spec: Target repo: /Users/k3ntaw/code/kgpt (Python kernel + FastAPI gateway + React PWA). Today: import_repo snapshots a repo's files into a project as attachments; propose_commit writes given files to a new branch. Goal: make a project a first-class workspace over a GitHub repository. Phase A (this bus, orchestrator repo): make the orchestrator installable into kgpt (`orchestrator install <target>`), since worktrees, hooks and the bus are rooted at ORCH_ROOT. Phase B (kgpt bus after restart with ORCH_ROOT=kgpt): the kgpt feature work, split into atomic specs from the scouts' findings.
acceptance: Phase A: `uv run orchestrator install /Users/k3ntaw/code/kgpt` scaffolds .orchestrator/, hooks, settings and .mcp.json in kgpt and a Planner session started there with ORCH_ROOT=kgpt passes status() and tests-green.sh on a kgpt worktree

Phase B plan.md in kgpt/.orchestrator lists atomic execute specs covering: repo binding on a project, refresh/sync from the repo with a change summary, per-file diff against the imported base, commit and pull request via proposal, Cowork UI surface for all of the above, handbook pages updated in the same change
